description: Aider-polyglot style (Python): implement a deterministic single-car lift simulation from a stub and an instructions file - collective control (keep the direction while requests remain ahead, serve only same-direction hall calls on the way, serve the opposite call at the turning floor), request availability at arrival time, idle jumps, nearest-floor tie-breaking and door/travel time accounting. The unit tests hold the hand-traced stop sequences and the post-turn verifier gives a repair round with the test output, like aider's second try.
